info.name: GROSINT V2 API Collection
info.description: Complete API collection for GROSINT V2 Backend - Authentication, User Management, Search, and Admin Operations

item.name: Authentication

request.description: Authenticate user with phone number and password. Returns JWT tokens. Tokens are automatically saved to environment variables.
Refresh access token using refresh token. New access token is automatically saved.
Logout user and invalidate tokens. Both access and refresh tokens are blacklisted.
Change user password. New password must be at least 8 characters and meet strength requirements.
Get current authentication status and token information.
Get detailed token information including issued_at, expires_at, and user details.
Validate token and return user information. Returns user_id, email, is_active, and is_verified.
Send OTP to user email for verification. OTP expires in 10 minutes.

Verify OTP for the given email. OTP verification always sets isEmailOtpVerified=true. If email is detected as a government email (isGovId=true), isVerified is set to true immediately; otherwise, admin approval is required.
Resend OTP to user email. Generates a new OTP and sends it via email.

item.description: Authentication endpoints for login, logout, token management, and OTP verification

item.name: User Management
Signup Init (Create Minimal User + Send OTP)

request.description: Initiate signup by creating (or reusing) a minimal user with email + isGovId (derived from email domain) and sending an email OTP. After OTP is verified, complete signup using the Complete Signup endpoint.

Complete signup after OTP verification by updating the user's details. Uses email to identify the user; if multiple users exist for the same email, phone is required to uniquely identify (or bind) the user. Requires isEmailOtpVerified=true.
Get current authenticated user information including profile details, organization info, and verification status.
Update current user information. All fields are optional - only provided fields will be updated.
List users with pagination (admin only). Returns paginated list of users with metadata.
Delete a user by ID (admin only). Requires valid user_id as path parameter.

item.description: User management endpoints for CRUD operations

item.name: Search

request.description: Create and execute a phone lookup search. Returns search_id, results, and status. Phone number should be without country code.
Create and execute an email lookup search. Returns search_id, results from multiple services, and status.
Create and execute a vehicle lookup search. lookup_type: rc | fast-tag | chasis | chassis | all. For chassis-only, omit vehicle_number and provide chassis_number.
Bank account lookup by account_no + ifsc_code. Alternatively use upi for UPI lookup.
Verify ID: id_type = pan | dl | voter | passport. For dl, dob (DD-MM-YYYY) is required.
IP geolocation and security lookup via VPNAPI.io
IMEI device lookup via Kelpom RapidAPI
Check if phone number is virtual/throwaway via NumCheckr
Check if email is virtual/disposable via Email Intelligence RapidAPI
Get search results by search ID. Returns complete search information including results and status.

query.description: Optional user ID to filter searches

request.description: Get searches with pagination. If user_id is provided, returns searches for that user. Otherwise returns system searches.
Get search statistics including counts by type and status.

item.description: Search endpoints for phone and email lookups

item.name: History

query.description: Number of items per page (default: 10, min: 1, max: 100)

Optional. Filter by search type. Allowed: phone-lookup, email-lookup, domain-lookup, vehicle-rc, vehicle-fast-tag, vehicle-all, vehicle-chasis, username-lookup, ip-lookup, imei-lookup, virtual-number, virtual-email, bank-account, verify-id, dark-web-leak, seeker-lookup

request.description: Get paginated list of user's search history with metadata only. Returns: id, queryType, queryInput, status, createdAt. Use the detail endpoint to get full information including flattenedResults. Optional searchType filter: phone-lookup, email-lookup, domain-lookup, vehicle-rc, vehicle-fast-tag, vehicle-all, vehicle-chasis, username-lookup, ip-lookup, imei-lookup, virtual-number, virtual-email, bank-account, verify-id, dark-web-leak, seeker-lookup.

Get full history details by ID including flattenedResults. Use this endpoint when clicking on a history item from the list. Returns complete history information with flattened results ready for UI rendering.
Delete all history data for the current authenticated user. Only history data is deleted; user, credits, and credits_transaction data remain untouched. Returns the count of deleted history records.

item.description: History endpoints for viewing user's search history with paginated metadata and detailed results. searchType filter allowed values: phone-lookup, email-lookup, domain-lookup, vehicle-rc, vehicle-fast-tag, vehicle-all, vehicle-chasis, username-lookup, ip-lookup, imei-lookup, virtual-number, virtual-email, bank-account, verify-id, dark-web-leak, seeker-lookup

item.name: Seeker

exec: console.log('✅ Seeker link ID saved: ' + jsonData.data.id);

request.description: Create a new Seeker tracking link for geolocation/device-info collection. templates: nearyou, gdrive, whatsapp, telegram, zoom, captcha, secure_briefing, clearance_check, secure_message, official_alert. Returns url (short/external), external_url (when anonymizer enabled), short_url, short_code, direct_url. Use url/external_url to share. Set SEEKER_ANONYMIZE_URL_SERVICE (v.gd/is.gd/tinyurl) to hide your domain.

query.description: Number of links to return (default 20, max 100)

request.description: List all Seeker links for the authenticated user. Returns items with id, template, title, url (short), short_url, short_code, direct_url, created_at.
Get Seeker link details by ID. Requires seeker_link_id (set automatically after Create Seeker Link).

query.description: Number of results to return (default 50, max 100)

request.description: Get results (device info + location) for a Seeker link. Each result includes platform, browser, ip, ip_info, lat, lon, accuracy, status, created_at.
Delete a Seeker link. Only the link owner can delete. Results are not deleted.

item.description: Seeker geolocation/device-info collection. Create tracking links with short URLs (e.g. /l/x7k2ab9c) or anonymized URLs (v.gd/is.gd) via SEEKER_ANONYMIZE_URL_SERVICE. Templates: nearyou (dating), gdrive (Google Drive), whatsapp, telegram, zoom, captcha, secure_briefing, clearance_check, secure_message, official_alert. Share url with targets; they redirect to the tracking page. Retrieve device info + location when targets visit and grant permission. Results appear in History (queryType: seeker-lookup).

item.name: Admin
🔐 Authentication

request.description: Initiate signup for an admin email (creates minimal user + sends OTP). Note: Actual admin privileges cannot be self-assigned; an existing admin must grant role via admin processes.
Complete signup by adding phone/password/profile after OTP verification. Admin role assignment is not done here.

exec: console.log('✅ Admin token saved to environment');

request.description: Login with phone number and password to get access token. The token will be automatically saved to the 'admin_token' and 'access_token' environment variables.
